entities.name: Judith
entities.description: Grand dame and speaker of the Cult of Rakdos on Ravnica, a performer who ambitiously sought Rakdos's seat and misdirected investigators; later tortured by Massacre Girl.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Ravnican guild of hedonists led by the demon Rakdos.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Demon guildmaster of the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: Rakdos assassin hired by Judith who later tortured her.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Detective killed by Massacre Girl at Judith's behest; the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations figure who gathered the guildheads.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Assassinated during the celebration at Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Investigator imprisoned by Judith in a crystal skull.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: Central dryad of Trostani who organized the murders in retribution.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: Site of the celebration where Zegana was assassinated.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Selesnya guildhall where the truth of the murders was revealed.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: Rakdos territory where Judith confronted Kos.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Judith fought defending Ravnica.

events.summary: Judith, jealous of Rakdos's adoration, assembles an entourage who echo her complaints about the guildmaster.
events.quote: She believed that the guild needed new leadership

events.summary: Judith fights to defend Ravnica in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Judith fought in defense of Ravnica during the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Judith hires Massacre Girl to kill Alquist Proft as a message to the investigators.
events.quote: She hired the Rakdos assassin Massacre Girl to kill Alquist Proft

events.summary: Judith misdirects Kaya and Kellan to implicate Rakdos, then imprisons Agrus Kos in a crystal skull.
events.quote: She then imprisoned Kos in a crystal skull to prevent him from interfering.

events.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi, Oba is revealed as the organizer of the murders and attacks the guild leaders; Judith runs but is stopped by Massacre Girl.
events.quote: When Oba attacked the guild leaders, Judith ran away

events.summary: Massacre Girl takes Judith and spends over a year torturing her in a hidden safehouse.
events.quote: spent more than a year torturing her in one of her hidden safehouses

relations.quote: is the grand dame of the Cult of Rakdos on Ravnica

relations.note: hired her; later tortured by her
